evidence: The LiF films were highly crystalline, as can be seen in the GI-XRD patterns in Figures 5 and 6. The LiF films deposited at 275−350 °C showed crystalline LiF. The films deposited at 275 °C showed prominent magnesium impurities, which was also indicated by the GI-XRD experiment (Figure 5). The films are extremely rough, with 60 −80 nm films showing root-mean-square roughnesses of 20 nm.
